warnings.text:
InvalidMonitor extends Schema.TaggedError; a schema error declaration, schema error InvalidMonitor { … }, writes the same failure with its Schema.
  No quick fix: a schema error's tag is its name.

Variant extends Context.Service; in VibeLang a service is a service declaration: service Variant { … }.
  No quick fix: its members come from VariantService; write them in the declaration. Keep its key in the declaration: static readonly key = "@smthrs/harness/QuickJSSandbox/Variant".
